subtitle: Lesson 4 · Why the address space is running out

code:
IPv4:  32 bits   ~4.3 billion addresses
IPv6:  128 bits  ~340 undecillion addresses
       (3.4 x 10^38 — practically inexhaustible)
caption: IANA allocated the last free IPv4 blocks years ago.
The :: shorthand can only appear once per address — ambiguous otherwise.

code:
Dual-stack device:
  eth0: 192.168.1.50/24           (IPv4, still works)
  eth0: 2001:db8:85a3::50/64      (IPv6, also works)
caption: Azure and AWS both support dual-stack networking.
